name: react-resume-template
description: Ananthan's personal portfolio website that began as a React resume template and expanded into a multi-feature Next.js 13 admin/portfolio application, covering finance dashboards, invoices, tasks, notes, org charts, Gantt and process-flow views, PDF autofill and e-signing, supplier risk, and anomaly detection with an ESP32 camera feed. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
